chunks: And from him and Ali ibn Abdullah, both together, from Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far, who said:

I wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him), 'A woman died and left her husband, and her two parents, or her grandfather, or her grandmother. How should her inheritance be distributed?' So he (peace be upon him) signed: 'For the husband is the half, and what remains, so it is for the two parents'.
And it has also been reported as well that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) provided the one-sixth for the grandfather and the grandmother.
ai.seo_question: How is a woman's inheritance divided if she leaves a husband, parents, and grandparents?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi addresses the specific inheritance scenario of a woman leaving a husband and ascendants, establishing the husband's half share and the parents' residual portion. It highlights the scholarly discussion regarding the grandfather's share, noting a supplementary report where he receives one-sixth, which reflects the interplay between Quranic fixed shares and the Imam's interpretive authority in Shia jurisprudence. This case is pivotal in understanding the hierarchy of heirs and the treatment of grandparents when parents are absent.

en.hubeali: And from him and Ali Bin Abdullah, both together from Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far who said,

‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman died and left her husband, and her parent, or her grandfather, or her grandmother. How should her inheritance be distributed?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> signed: ‘For the husband is the half, and what remains, so it is for the two parents’.
And it has also been reported as well that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandfather and the grandmother’.
en.sarwar: It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith and Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah all from Ibrahim from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja‘far who has narrated the following: “I once wrote to abu Muhammad, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and asked that a woman has died leaving behind her husband, her parents or her grandfather or her grandmother; how is the legacy distributed? He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, signed the answer that said, ‘The share of the husband is one-half and the rest belongs to the parents.
It is also narrated that the Messenger of Allah, provided for the grandfather and grandmother one-sixth.’”
